  • Page name contrast

    Part of the 'Australia' header text blends in with the background image too well. Adding a stroke to the text could solve this easily!

  • Background colors

    The dark backgrounds look out of place. The header image has bright colors and sceneries, then the rest of the page is dark and dull.
